intro: Trying to find Minnesota scholarships that consider financial need and stay under the five-thousand-dollar range usually means sorting through a mix of smaller, more targeted awards. This filtered USA view brings those rows together so you can compare programs without losing time on listings outside your budget range or location focus. The set below spans categories such as education, community, disability, STEM, arts, and miscellaneous topics, with examples tied to study paths from education and business to natural resources, law, and philosophy. Award amounts vary by listing, and deadlines differ by program, so it is worth checking each row closely—especially since some dates appear to be coming up soon. Requirements also vary, with some scholarships looking lighter-touch than others and some asking for essays while others may not.
